title: budget_cue_injected runtime event payload
description: TER F6 push tier (2026-09-03, TODO2 T0.2 / 设计稿 §3.3/§10-S0): a neutral budget fact injected when the remaining evaluation wallclock crosses a tier threshold (<600 / <300 / <120s) — remaining seconds + rounds used + trigger tier only, no suggestion. Mechanical single-writer record; push is off by default (zero injections) and at most 4 cues per run (verifier-enforced).

remaining_seconds.description: Remaining evaluation wallclock in seconds at the cue point.

rounds_used.description: Tool rounds used so far in this run at the cue point.
